title: The Engine Shed
pitch: Tanner ran for Victor once. Now he strips cars in the engine shed under Varga's wing. Victor wants his share.

clue_a.label: The boxcar
lines: Car parts stripped and crated, numbers ground off. A Varga chalk mark on every crate.

clue_b.label: The van
lines: A payment book in the burned-out van. Tanner hands Varga half of everything. Not a partner. A tenant.
